楼机械规约写明：缺少配重时钟锤不能自动运行。楼梯上的油漆呈暗蓝色。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"第五日许砚听到雷击说，误以为停摆由雷击造成；乔素知道自己取下了配重。调查者依据第二日取下配重的记录，确认停摆早于第三日的雷雨。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-KPHO","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aa9bb7ac6-6a19-41f9-a6c3-dd573d5668a7:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:a9bb7ac6-6a19-41f9-a6c3-dd573d5668a7"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["第五日许砚听到雷击说，误以为停摆由雷击造成；乔素知道自己取下了配重。调查者依据第二日取下配重的记录，确认停摆早于第三日的雷雨。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"补瓦匠在西屋更换三片瓦，工钱按瓦片数量结算，与钟楼机械无关。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-KPHO","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aff8e49ed-1132-44f0-8ff1-1f7bb9f6da68:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:ff8e49ed-1132-44f0-8ff1-1f7bb9f6da68"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["补瓦匠在西屋更换三片瓦，工钱按瓦片数量结算，与钟楼机械无关。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"许砚","kind":"entity","text":"许砚","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"许砚","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:b0e80b69-515d-4626-81c1-708f5899e623","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["许砚"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"乔素","kind":"entity","text":"乔素","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"乔素","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:b9faae10-3f9c-4b27-b8f3-41e19a81dfde","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["乔素"]},{"documentId":"D8","title":"倒悬钟楼·原文日序","kind":"entity","text":"倒悬钟楼·原文日序","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"倒悬钟楼·原文日序","entityType":"world-group","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"world-group","sour
